Northstar Labs' focus on reliable Python services connects with my work on Queue Lab. I am interested in the Backend Engineer role and its emphasis on task queues and service latency.

In Queue Lab, I built a Python task queue with retry handling and latency instrumentation. That project gave me a concrete way to explore how retries affect task processing and how measurements can guide improvements.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this experience relates to your service reliability work. Thank you for considering my application.
